The Vahla are nomads, with no planet to call their own. While it is known that they are searching for their homeworld, it is unknown if that homeworld is where they originated from, or where they intend to settle, or even the planet's name.
Vahla speak their own harsh language of Vahla, with most learning Basic to perform trade in the galactic community.

The Vahla are generally vagabonds, constantly plying interstellar space in an ongoing quest to locate their homeworld. They can often be encountered in small-scale acts of piracy, petty thievery, or in bounty hunting.
